intents.title: latest camera original for a shot
intents.description: Returns the most recent camera original version for a specified shot, including storage URI and technical metadata.

intents.title: lineage chain to latest edit export
intents.description: Traces the full derivation chain from camera original through all intermediate versions to the latest edit export for a shot.

intents.title: shots with dailies but no edit export
intents.description: Identifies shots that have completed dailies publication but are missing edit exports, indicating a potential workflow blockage.

intents.title: shots ready for turnover but not delivered
intents.description: Finds shots with completed edit exports that have not yet been delivered to vendors via turnover packages.

intents.title: package members
intents.description: Lists all version members of a specific delivery package (turnover or archive).

intents.title: source relink keys
intents.description: Returns relink metadata (fps, timecode in/out, clip name, reel) for a shot's camera original, used for editorial conform.

intents.title: latest versions by type
intents.description: Shows the most recent version of each type (camera original, dailies proxy, edit export, etc.) for a shot.

intents.title: archive status for a production
intents.description: Returns archive completion summary: how many shots have been archived versus total shot count.
